post_title: Got a $200k startup offer but visa expires in 7 weeks
concerns_or_questions_summary: Received a $200K offer from a Palo Alto AI startup that may sponsor later, but H-1B work authorization expires June 12 (in seven weeks) and the user has no remaining H-1B lottery attempts. Considering Day 1 CPT via a second MS program or working until June 12 then going home and continuing remotely. Asking which option is safest for continuous work authorization.
